title: PAWS paraphrase pairs (PAWS-Wiki, labeled_final test)
decision: whether two sentences with nearly the same words have the same meaning

source.name: PAWS: Paraphrase Adversaries from Word Scrambling (arXiv:1904.01130)

licence: tag "other"; card text: "The dataset may be freely used for any purpose, although acknowledgement of Google LLC ("Google") as the data source would be appreciated. The dataset is provided "AS IS" without any warranty, express or implied."
notes: 500 yes + 500 no, sampled per class (seed 20261007) from the 8,000 test pairs (3536 paraphrases, 4464 non-paraphrases); gold yes = source label 1. The pairs were generated by word swapping and back-translation and judged by human raters; the sentences keep the tokenised form of the source (spaces before punctuation). Licence: custom text, not one of the standard licences, hence kept as rebuild script only although the text allows free use for any purpose. The training split of the same configuration (49,401 pairs) is public: a model trained on it is in-domain. Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 6 of 1000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 2 more to restore the balance of the classes; 992 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 10 of 992 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 6 more to restore the balance of the classes; 976 items remain.
